LESSON: CHILDREN’S GOVERNMENT IN SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.5: Children’s Government in school

● Collaboration: Learners share experiences on functions of Children’s Government in school.

● Integrity: Learners simulate the Children’s Government in session in school

● Social Justice: Learners accord privileges without favour as they role-play the functions of Children’s Government
